test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MONTH' is written as 'OMPHT', and 'MARCH' is written as 'AMTHC'. How will 'APRIL' be written in that language?
solution:
Table of alphabet positional value is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

**'MONTH' is written as 'OMPHT'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3474e7592d8925e62d25ab0b8018cff3e36b7a75460e4bd21c43ecccfc6dfe0b.png] 

 

**'MARCH' is written as 'AMTHC'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9441da31cebcd48389b565589af1594debd7c62931245791ed7979c79755dca2.png] 

Similarly,

**'APRIL' is written as 'PATLI'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f25268882402e405129c5e49085d69aa769dbe93abb67fd5aa6c0192e226bd98.png] 

Hence,** PATLI **is the **correct answer.**
